llm.summary: This is a straightforward Douyin search helper that uses browser automation to open Douyin pages and summarize visible results, with no hidden code, credential use, or data-changing behavior shown.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose—searching Douyin videos, extracting visible metadata, and browsing trending content—matches the documented commands and examples.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill tells an AI agent to use browser automation against douyin.com, including opening search pages, taking snapshots, and optionally clicking video cards. This is purpose-aligned and scoped to Douyin, but users should expect external web browsing.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec or code, but the skill documentation and skill.json require the agent-browser CLI while registry requirements say no binaries are required. This looks like a packaging/metadata mismatch rather than unsafe behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Network access to douyin.com and browser automation are proportionate for a search/scraping helper. No environment variables, credentials, local files, or protected paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background service, credential storage, login bypass, posting, downloading, or account mutation is documented. The instructions include closing the browser after use.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this skill opens Douyin in a browser automation tool and reads visible search results. It does not show hidden code or credential collection, but you should ensure agent-browser is trusted and avoid logging in or entering sensitive information during automated browsing.

evidence.explanation: The skill instructs the agent to drive a browser, read page snapshots, and click Douyin video cards. This is expected for a Douyin search skill and is scoped to douyin.com, but it is still external browser automation.
evidence.snippet: agent-browser open "https://www.douyin.com/search/{keyword}" ... agent-browser snapshot -i -c -d 4 ... agent-browser click @eN

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use it for intended Douyin searches only, and avoid entering account credentials or asking it to bypass login or anti-bot prompts.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may open Douyin pages and interact with visible search results on the user's behalf.

evidence.explanation: The package declares an agent-browser dependency in skill.json, while the registry requirements supplied for review list no required binaries. This is an under-declared dependency in metadata, but the dependency is also plainly documented in SKILL.md and is central to the skill's purpose.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Confirm agent-browser is installed from a trusted source before using the skill; maintainers should align registry metadata with skill.json.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The skill will only work in an environment where agent-browser is available, even though the registry requirement summary says no binary is required.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses browser automation and has a minor dependency metadata mismatch, both disclosed and purpose-aligned.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, privileged account access, posting rights, or mutation authority are requested.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: No local file indexing, persistent memory, credential handling, or inter-agent data exchange is shown.
